goals: Verify the blog controller correctly handles various routes and rendering modes (SSR, CSR) by delivering expected content and loading appropriate JavaScript resources.
activities: Set the mock environment to 'local'.
Create an application instance.
Wait for the application to be ready.
Wait for webpack to be ready for the application.
Send an HTTP GET request to the root path '/'.
Assert the HTTP response status is 200.

Assert the response body contains '

Egg Vue

'.
Assert the response indicates Server-Side Rendering (SSR).
Assert the response includes the 'blog/home' development JavaScript resource.
Restore the mock environment.
Send an HTTP GET request to '/blog/about'.
Assert the HTTP response status is 200.
Assert the response indicates Server-Side Rendering (SSR).
Assert the response includes the 'blog/about' development JavaScript resource.
Restore the mock environment.
Send an HTTP GET request to '/blog/csr'.
Assert the HTTP response status is 200.
Assert the response indicates Client-Side Rendering (CSR).
Assert the response includes the 'blog/home' development JavaScript resource.
Restore the mock environment.
Close the application.
